items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: He says to me, 'Well, I spoke to Mr. Bernie Rothcall (? Rofcaw?). He said he wasn't interested and didn't want to talk about it.'

ctx.x: I was so excited. And in a couple of days I called him back. 'I haven't had time to have an answer yet; I'm waiting on an answer.' So I said OK, and I'm really nervous

now. I finally pinned him, and a few days had passed and I'm getting a little shaky, because what's the...what are we talking about here? And he says to me, 'Well, I spoke to Mr. Bernie Rothcall (? Rofcaw?). He said he wasn't interested and didn't want to talk about it. Those were his words.'
